title: DeepResearchChunk
description: A streaming chunk of a Deep Research response.

type.description: The type of this streaming chunk. On the `pro-visual` tier, `html_delta` chunks stream an HTML version of the report after the report content completes, and a final `html` chunk marks the end of that stream.

request_id.description: The unique identifier for this request.

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chunk was created.

round.description: Current research round. Present only in `queries`, `search_done`, and `analysis` chunks.

latency.description: Latency in milliseconds for the stage represented by this chunk.

status.description: Pipeline progress copy. Present only in `status` chunks.

plan_id.description: Plan ID carried by `plan` chunks. The client must echo this back as `plan_id` when entering Phase 2.

queries.description: Sub-queries generated for this round. Present only in `queries` chunks.

search_result_count.description: Total number of search results returned this round. Present only in `search_done` chunks.

search_results.description: Search results for this round, one group per sub-query. Present only in `search_done` chunks.

choices.description: Incremental choices for the final report. Present in `content` and `finish` chunks.

visual.description: Visual material for one report section. Present only in `visual` chunks, emitted on the `pro-visual` tier.

html_delta.description: An incremental fragment of the HTML report. Present only in `html_delta` chunks. Concatenate the fragments in order to rebuild the full page.

delta.description: The next fragment of the HTML page.

DeepResearchAnalysis.description: Analysis output for one research round. Carried by `analysis` chunks.

findings.description: Key findings extracted from this round.

should_continue.description: Whether the pipeline should run another research round.

follow_up_suggestions.description: Suggested research directions for the next round.

DeepResearchAngle.description: A single research angle within the plan.

interpretation_id.description: The meaning ID this angle serves. `"general"` denotes a cross-interpretation angle.

queries.description: Search queries planned for this angle.

sub_question_ids.description: Sub-question IDs covered by this angle.

DeepResearchBrief.description: Report outline and evidence set. Carried by `brief` chunks.

report_type.description: Report type, classified by the LLM from the question. `general`: general synthesis; `comparison`: cross-entity comparison; `trend`: time-axis trend analysis; `how-to`: step-by-step guide; `evaluation`: ranked or scored evaluation; `framework`: methodology or scoring framework; `deep_explainer`: deep explanation of a single topic; `theoretical_analysis`: scholarly analysis across multiple theoretical lenses; `landscape_mapping`: taxonomy and players in a domain; `multi_part`: composite question with explicit sub-questions.

secondary_report_types.description: Secondary type tags for hybrid reports, combined with `report_type`.

total_word_budget.description: Total word budget for the report.

assertiveness_required.description: Whether the report must deliver a clear verdict.

tables.description: Table metadata to render in the report. Mutually exclusive with `presentation_notes`.

presentation_notes.description: Presentation notes for reports that do not use tables. Mutually exclusive with `tables`.

sub_question_to_section_map.description: Mapping from sub-question ID to section ID.

DeepResearchChunkChoice.description: A single choice in a Deep Research streaming chunk. Carried by `content` and `finish` chunks.

index.description: The index of this choice. Usually `0`.

finish_reason.description: The reason generation stopped. `null` in `content` chunks; populated in the `finish` chunk.

DeepResearchChunkDelta.description: Incremental content in a Deep Research streaming chunk.

content.description: Incremental report text. Concatenate across `content` chunks to build the final report.

DeepResearchEvidence.description: A single piece of evidence within a section.

source_indices.description: Source indices cited by this evidence (matching `brief.references[].index`).

DeepResearchInterpretation.description: An ambiguous term and its candidate meanings.

meanings.description: All candidate meanings for this term.

chosen.description: The meaning ID the LLM picked by default.

reasoning.description: The LLM's rationale for the chosen meaning.

DeepResearchMeaning.description: A candidate meaning for an ambiguous term.

DeepResearchMeta.description: Usage and latency metadata for the Deep Research call. Carried by `usage` chunks.

num_search_queries.description: Total number of search queries executed across all rounds.

total_rounds.description: Total number of research rounds completed.

total_search_count.description: Total search results accumulated across all rounds.

billed_tier.description: The tier actually billed for this request.

DeepResearchOutlineSection.description: A single section in the report outline.

section_id.description: Unique section ID, referenced by `sub_question_to_section_map` and `table.placement`.

table_ids.description: Table IDs belonging to this section.

covers_sub_questions.description: Sub-question IDs covered by this section.

target_words.description: Target word count for this section.

DeepResearchPlan.description: Research plan generated in Phase 1. Carried by `plan` chunks.

interpretations.description: Ambiguous terms in the question along with their possible meanings. Empty when the question has no ambiguity.

angles.description: Research angles the plan will explore.

requires_selection.description: When `true`, the SSE stream ends at this `plan` chunk and waits for the client to continue via Phase 2 (`plan_id` + `selections`). When `false`, research continues automatically.

index.description: Reference index; cited in the report body as `[^N]`.

DeepResearchTable.description: Table metadata referenced from an outline section.

description.description: Description of the table contents, guiding how the report-writing stage should populate the cells.

placement.description: Section ID this table belongs to.

DeepResearchUnresolved.description: Items the brief stage flagged as unresolved.

DeepResearchVerdictScaffold.description: Structured scaffold for reports that need to deliver a verdict.

verdict_type.description: Shape of the verdict. `ranked_list`: ordered ranking; `single_pick`: a single best answer; `tiered_recommendation`: tiered recommendation; `qualified_pick`: conditional recommendation.

items_expected.description: Expected number of items in the verdict.

DeepResearchVisual.description: Visual material for one report section. Carried by `visual` chunks on the `pro-visual` tier.

section_id.description: The report section this material belongs to, matching `brief.outline[].section_id`.

DeepResearchVisualImage.description: An image selected for a report section.

caption.description: A short caption for the image.

visual_evidence.description: Why this image supports the section's content.

source_page.description: URL of the page the image was found on.

DeepResearchVisualVideo.description: A video selected for a report section.

source_page.description: URL of the page the video was found on.

title.description: The title of the result page.

url.description: The URL of the result page.

highlight.description: Query-relevant highlight snippets. Returned only if highlight.enable is true.

full_content.description: Full raw page content. Returned only if full_content.enable is true.

favicon.description: The favicon URL of the result site.

cover_image.description: The page cover image. Returned only when `include_images` is true and the page has a cover image.

description.description: Text description of the cover image.

images.description: In-body images of the page, in order of appearance. Returned only when `include_images` is true.

SearchResultGroup.description: A group of search results for a single sub-query.

query.description: The sub-query that produced these results.

results.description: The search results for this sub-query.

latency.description: Search latency for this query in milliseconds.
